info.title: API.SH: Chaves na Mão
info.description: The Chaves na Mão API from API.SH: public Chaves na Mão data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Chaves na Mão agency and its listings
get.description:
A real estate agency on Chaves na Mão: name, CRECI, verified flag, logo, phones and address, median, lowest and highest sale and rent prices of its stock, and its listings (same fields as the search). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chaves-na-mao-agency

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agency id (the number after id- in a chavesnamao.com.br/imobiliaria/... link) or the link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Chaves na Mão listing or new development: everything the search returns plus nearby transport with distances, contact options the publisher accepts, breadcrumb, active flag and creation date. Pass an id or link, or `latest=true` with search filters to open the first current match.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chaves-na-mao-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Alternative to id: the listing link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first listing the search with the other params returns.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest: search location.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: With latest: search property type.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: With latest: sale, rent or new.

get.description:
Search Chaves na Mão (Brazilian property portal) for sale, rent or new developments with every filter the site offers: property type (several at once), location (state, city, zone or neighbourhood; a site slug or a name), minimum bedrooms, bathrooms and parking spaces, price and area range, amenities, pet friendly, with condominium, owner-direct listings, construction stage of new developments; sorted by relevance, price or area. Each listing: id, link, title, reference, transaction, property type, price (and top price for developments), areas, bedrooms, bathrooms, suites, parking, development status, address with coordinates, amenities, pet friendly, accepts trade, description, video and 360 tour, photos, publisher (agencies with name, CRECI, phones, address and logo; private owners with the name the site shows, no phones or address), publish and update dates. Also returns the total, the price range of the results and the site search link. The site serves at most 333 pages of 30. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chaves-na-mao-search

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: sale (default), rent or new (new developments).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: apartamentos, casas, casas-em-condominio, kitnet, flat, loft, coberturas, chacaras, terrenos, terrenos-em-condominio, sala-comercial, casa-comercial, ponto-comercial, galpao, terreno-comercial, predio, garagem, fazendas.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A site location slug (sp-sao-paulo for a city, sp for a state, brasil) or a city / neighbourhood name, resolved with the site's own autocomplete (see /chaves-na-mao/v1/locations).

parameters.name: neighborhood
parameters.description: Neighbourhood or zone slug within the city (pinheiros, zona-oeste).

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: Minimum bedrooms (1-10).

parameters.name: bathrooms
parameters.description: Minimum bathrooms (1-10).

parameters.name: parking
parameters.description: Minimum parking spaces (1-10).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in BRL (monthly rent for rentals).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in BRL.

parameters.name: area_min
parameters.description: Smallest area in m².

parameters.name: area_max
parameters.description: Largest area in m².

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated amenity names or ids: piscina, academia, churrasqueira, elevador, varanda, mobiliado, portaria, salao-de-festas... (see /chaves-na-mao/v1/amenities).

parameters.name: pet_friendly
parameters.description: true: pet-friendly only.

parameters.name: with_condominium
parameters.description: true: properties in a condominium only.

parameters.name: owner_direct
parameters.description: true: listings published by the owner (no agency).

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: New developments: comma-separated na-planta, em-construcao, pronto-para-morar.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, area_asc, area_desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-333).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
